item.title: Why are my emails going to spam? The DNS reasons, and how to fix them
item.description: Short answer: usually because your domain is missing SPF, DKIM or DMARC, so the big inboxes can't prove the email is really from you. The three records SPF: one TXT record listing every service allowed to send email as you. DKIM: a signature on each email. You turn it on at your email provider, then add its record.
